_lab.title: Full comp round
_lab.description: The complete verdict-routed hand: assigned card with a 3-raise cycler and a finished comp, MY PICK, a competitive challenger, two declined cards, canon, registers, steer, and followup.

title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Teletext Service, raised by the hand it beat.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The catalog as a broadcast index: pages, not sections.
options.viewport: P100 index page, releases as numbered rows.
options.risk: Reads retro-novelty when the grid is not strict.

raised.raise: The index now owns its whole viewport as one continuous signal field.
Pictogram discipline: one icon grammar across every row.
Tile repetition carries the rhythm between pages.

options.label: The Program Guide
options.thesis: Releases as a printed evening schedule.
options.viewport: A dated grid of listings with one featured box.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Aicher Olympic Program
options.thesis: Every release an event in one pictogram system.
options.case: Fuses cleanly; loses narrowly on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads institutional if the palette stays cold.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.case: Fuses poorly: the audience does not identify with ceramic wayfinding.

options.label: Animated Terminal
options.case: Fuses poorly: the product is not a developer tool.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
